description: PAID $0.25 USDC. Quick due-diligence on a token or wallet: allow/caution/avoid with confidence, trust score, top 3 red flags, DEX liquidity and holder concentration. Chains base, ethereum, solana. No charge on failure. Returns JSON allow, caution, or avoid, a trust score, the top 3 red flags, DEX liquidity, and holder concentration.

address.description: Token contract, Solana mint, or wallet. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint. Example: 0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the token or wallet. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: base. Allowed values: base, ethereum, solana.

name: dd_quick
title: Crypto Due-Diligence quick check ($0.25)
